summary: Focused frontend login verification for the Sound Clinic demo tenant on preview URL. Drove the actual /login form with Playwright (not JSON API) for all 4 requested accounts. All logins succeeded: no 'Invalid email or password' banner, redirected out of /login into the authenticated app shell (sidebar with clinic 'The Sound Clinic — Bangaluru' PREMIUM tag, user avatar/name in footer, and role-appropriate landing page). /api/auth/me returned 200 for every account after login. Spot check on owner account confirms data pages (/patients, /appointments, /referrals) render with real seeded data (Dr. Rajesh Iyer as clinic owner, staff list including Dr. Aditi Krishnan, Dr. Vikram Reddy, Meera Bhat, Suresh Kumar; calendar shows real appointments for week of 27 Jul 2026).

Role-based routing works as expected: audiologist -> /test (Hearing Tests), clinic_owner -> /patients dashboard, front_desk -> /patients dashboard.

Main agent's fix (a) ran seed_demo_premium.py to create tenant + 6 users + patients + appointments + referrals, (b) batch-updated email_verified=true for the 6 Sound Clinic users. Verification: browser login form now succeeds for owner/audiologist/front_desk and app shell renders with correct role landing pages. Fix confirmed working.
